blocks.title: Get a useful answer, not just a list of links
blocks.description: Help Vetta choose a suitable way to research your question, organize community viewpoints and explain what the evidence does and does not support.

showcase.user_prompt: Research Zhihu discussions about moving from office work to working from home. Separate common experiences from individual cases and include sources.
showcase.assistant_reply: I’ll focus the search on that transition, group the experiences by theme and explain where the available sources are limited.

items.title: Choose a focused approach
items.description: Match the question to source research, an explanation or current discussions.

items.title: Organize the answer
items.description: Group relevant findings, keep sources close to claims and make uncertainty visible.

items.title: Stay on topic
items.description: Use external research when the task needs it, without adding unrelated searches to local work.

blocks.title: Use with Zhihu Search
blocks.content: This guide does not provide access to Zhihu by itself. For the Vetta workflow, install and connect Zhihu Search alongside it. The guide needs no separate access key. Independent advanced use is covered in the integration notes below.

blocks.title: From a question to a source-backed summary

items.title: Choose both members in Zhihu Research
items.description: Install Zhihu Research Guide together with Zhihu Search, then complete the search connection’s one-time setup.

items.title: Describe the result you want
items.description: Give Vetta a topic and a focus, such as common complaints, differing experiences or current discussions.

items.title: Review and follow up
items.description: Ask for source links, check the claims that matter to you and follow up on any gaps.

blocks.title: Research is still something to review
blocks.content: A summary of community views is not proof or a complete survey. Review the linked sources and their context. Queries through the companion connection use your Zhihu quota.
